resources.string: Instagram + YouTube allowance used up for now. More unlocks at 12:00 and 19:00. Go back to work.
Open Saemi Goals to set URL and token, then tap Refresh.
Could not load goals. Tap Refresh.

2 hours per day, phone and laptop combined, unlocked over the day: 30 min in the morning, +45 min at 12:00, +45 min at 19:00. When blocked, holding the button on the block screen for 1 min adds 15 min. Blocks the YouTube and Instagram apps and youtube.com / instagram.com in Chrome, Brave, Firefox, Samsung Internet, Edge and other browsers. Requires the Saemi accessibility service to be turned on.
Blocker is OFF: tap below, choose Saemi Goals and turn it on
Hold for 1 min to get 15 extra min

Stops you from switching the blocker off on impulse: Settings, uninstall and permission screens that show Saemi Goals are closed right away, and the server URL, token and package fields are locked. To turn it off, request an unlock and wait.
Protection is OFF: the blocker can be switched off in Settings anytime
Unlocked for %1$s: Settings and fields are open
The blocker itself is off, so nothing is protected. Turn it on in Accessibility settings.

Once on, turning the blocker off, uninstalling Saemi Goals or removing its permissions needs an unlock request, then a %1$d min wait, then a %2$d min window. Restarting the phone cancels a pending request.
Saemi protection is on. Request an unlock in the Saemi Goals app first.
Limits Instagram and YouTube (apps and websites in your browser) to 2 hours per day (30 min in the morning, +45 min at 12:00, +45 min at 19:00) and blocks them once the unlocked time is used up.
Could not load deadlines. Tap refresh.
Reminders 24 hours and 3 hours before an exercise or quiz is due
Add the "Saemi Uni deadlines" widget to your home screen. You get a notification 24h and 3h before each open deadline.

When enabled: at most once every 4 hours, briefly open Google Fit so data can sync to Google — after each home-screen widget refresh (then return home), and ~1s before the YouTube/Instagram blocker if that fires. Requires Google Fit installed. Not a guarantee; there is no official background sync API.
